replication.target_description: Study 5; main effect of Warning on mean agreement, full final sample (All), 2x2 between-subjects ANOVA crossing comparative framing and warning.

n.exclusions: Potential duplicate respondents excluded; 552 completed, 538 final. Memory-check failures are retained in the selected All analysis; the Passed Check analysis is separate.

notes: Primary titles verified. Original effect size and p are paired for the printed omnibus three-condition framing test; the narrower warning-versus-standard-less-than Tukey contrast has p=.037 but no printed effect size. The original group-count discrepancy is retained without correction. Replication selects the named Warn main effect in the full-sample Table 6; the alternative test of whether warning moderates the framing effect is Comp x Warn: F(1, 534)=1.12, p=.291, printed partial eta squared .002. Those alternative statistics are not mixed into the extracted Warn test. No single printed test directly equates the original three-condition omnibus test with the replication factorial Warning test.
